project: Castlevania: Harmony of Despair PS3 Recomp
approach: Static recompilation of the PS3 PSN release (EBOOT, 118 PRX modules and the Multistream SPU mixer) to C++ with ps3recomp, built into a native Windows program on the player's PC, with a D3D12 renderer
help: Testing the stages and the DLC characters
notes: No game data or keys are included. The player supplies their own PSN package (and .rap licence for the full version) and the game is built on their PC. Chapter 1 plays with sound and music; the PS3 firmware's ATRAC decoder is downloaded from Sony during setup.
